email.subject: Pistons Works: two quick fixes for Harbor Falls drivers
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I checked Pistons Works Auto Care's site. It doesn't adjust for mobile, and there's no tap-to-call number. Most people searching "auto repair Harbor Falls" are on their phone, often stuck somewhere, and if the site is hard to read and they can't tap to call you, they just call the next shop.

Also worth fixing: your hours aren't listed, so people can't tell if you're open before heading over.

I'm Alex, I run a small local web shop. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix. No obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
